note: Scores are 1-10 within each city's context. price_eur_m2 is the approximate mid-market asking benchmark used for the value score.

areas.name: Lozenets
areas.summary: The most consistently liquid district: embassy/tech-professional tenant pool, South Park, metro. Pays for itself in liquidity and rentability rather than headline yield.
watch_outs: Premium entry prices compress yield
Older brick stock needs renovation budgets

areas.name: Ivan Vazov
areas.summary: Quiet, central, next to South Park and NDK; vacancy 2-3%. Smaller market than Lozenets but the same tenant quality.
watch_outs: Thin supply - patience needed to buy well

areas.name: Center / NDK-Vitosha
areas.summary: The only Sofia micro-market where short lets clear strongly year-round (Vitosha Blvd corridor). Dual-strategy flexibility is the draw.
watch_outs: Short-let regulation tightening centrally
1980s brick walk-ups: check structure and no-elevator discount

areas.name: Krasno Selo
areas.summary: Metro line 3 re-rated the district; new-build pipeline at 2,200-2,900 EUR/m2 still ~15% below Lozenets for near-identical commutes.
watch_outs: Quality varies sharply between developments - check the developer's delivery record

areas.name: Mladost
areas.summary: Business-park corridor: the strongest pure rental yields in Sofia from corporate tenants, at the cost of prestige and growth ceiling.
watch_outs: Heavy new supply pipeline caps rent growth
Weekend/leisure short-let demand is weak

areas.name: Koukaki / Acropolis
areas.verdict: Blue chip - long let only for new buyers
areas.summary: Europe-class micro-location with the deepest resale market in central Athens. The AMA freeze (Districts 1-3, until end-2026) blocks new short-let registrations, so underwrite as a long let.
watch_outs: New short-let registrations frozen until 31 Dec 2026
Priced ~60% above Kypseli

areas.name: Pagrati
areas.summary: The best risk-adjusted balance in central Athens: walkable to the centre, strong professional long-let demand, outside the AMA freeze zone, steady gentrification anchored by the Goulandris museum.
watch_outs: Prices already moved - the deep-value window has closed

areas.name: Kypseli
areas.summary: The gentrification story of central Athens: asking prices +8.5% y/y (Mar 2026) yet still ~40% below Koukaki. Upcoming metro station strengthens the thesis. Large 60-100 m2 stock suits families and sharers.
watch_outs: Block-by-block variance - walk the street at night before offering
1960s-70s stock: budget seismic/engineering checks

areas.name: Glyfada / Riviera
areas.summary: The Ellinikon mega-project is re-rating the whole southern coast. Lowest yields in the Athens set but the strongest capital-growth thesis; premium tenant pool.
watch_outs: Yield compression - cash flow barely covers costs at current prices
Ellinikon delivery timeline risk

areas.name: Ampelokipi
areas.summary: Metro-served, dense employment (hospitals, offices, embassies). Unglamorous, dependable long-let demand and fair entry prices.
watch_outs: Limited short-let upside
Traffic-heavy main arteries - prefer side streets

areas.name: Palermo - Kalsa / Centro Storico
areas.summary: Lowest entry prices of any major Italian city centre with rising tourism; 447 active listings give real choice. Italy's 5-year CGT exemption pairs well with a renovate-and-hold plan.
watch_outs: Cadastral irregularities endemic - independent geometra survey is non-negotiable
Resale liquidity thinner than mainland cities

areas.name: Palermo - Politeama / Liberta
areas.summary: Palermo's established prime: liberty-era buildings, the city's best long-let tenant pool and the easiest resale. Less upside than Kalsa, far less project risk.
watch_outs: Premium over Centro Storico without the same growth story

areas.name: Catania - Centro / Via Etnea
areas.summary: Sicily's economic engine: university plus the 'Etna Valley' tech cluster (ST Microelectronics expansion) gives year-round tenant demand the tourist towns lack.
watch_outs: Seismic zone - verify the building's structural class
Slower resale than Palermo's centre

areas.name: Syracuse - Ortigia
areas.summary: The strongest nightly rates in Sicily outside Taormina, with an international resale audience. A short-let business first, a property second.
watch_outs: Seasonality: Apr-Oct carries the year
Historic-building maintenance (humidity, salt air)
